meta.name: ulw-plan
meta.description: ACTIVATES ONLY on an explicit user request for the ulw-plan workflow: the user themselves saying ulw-plan, ulw plan, /skill:ulw-plan, or asking in their own words for a work plan before coding. NEVER self-activates: a bare ulw/ultrawork run, an agent-side routing decision, or reading this file is not a request, and the plan-gated reviewers (metis/momus) stay locked without a user request plus a written .omo/plans plan file. Explore-first planning consultant (Prometheus) that grounds in the codebase, asks only the forks exploration cannot resolve - or researches them to best practice when the intent is fuzzy - waits for explicit approval, then writes ONE decision-complete work plan a worker executes with zero further interview. Triggers: ulw-plan, ulw plan, plan this, make a plan, plan before coding, interview me, break this down, start planning, plan mode.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把模糊的编码想法变成可执行的实施计划
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你希望在动手写代码前先把方案讨论清楚、避免返工。
copy.tagline_en: Turn vague coding ideas into an executable implementation plan
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to finalize the approach before coding to avoid rework.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会以「规划顾问」身份工作:先探索代码库、做只读分析来弄清任务意图,只问必要的问题,拿不准时采用默认方案;等你明确批准后,在 .omo/ 目录写出一份决策完整的工作计划。它全程只写计划,不改代码、不实施。
howto.when: 仅当用户自己明确要求 ulw-plan 工作流时才触发:说出「ulw-plan」「ulw plan」「/skill:ulw-plan」,或要求写代码前先做计划。用户未主动要求时,不会自行触发。

say.text: 先别写代码,帮我做一份实施计划。
say.note: 进入规划模式,只调研与写计划

say.text: 用 ulw-plan 把登录改造拆成分步计划。
say.note: 明确指定 ulw-plan 工作流

say.text: 采访我,把需求问清楚再出计划。

howto.what_en: Claude works as a planning consultant: read-only exploration, intent verdict, only essential questions (or adopted defaults), waits for your approval, then writes one decision-complete plan under .omo/. It never implements.
howto.when_en: Only on explicit user request for ulw-plan: user says "ulw-plan", "ulw plan", "/skill:ulw-plan", or asks in their own words for a plan before coding. Never self-activates.

say_en.text: Don't write code yet — draft me an implementation plan.
say_en.note: Enters plan mode: explore and draft only.

say_en.text: Use ulw-plan to break the login rework into a plan.
Interview me, then write the plan once requirements are clear.
